Definition: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) high, upper; 1a) of Davidic king exalted above monarchs; n m; 2) Highest, Most High; 2a) name of God; 2b) of rulers, either monarchs or angel-princes
